Maria (Partnerships): FYI — new SI cohort starts next month. We need to lock down two things: a lightweight infra access flow for partner engineers, and a cert path that ties to our marketplace listing.
Ajay (Solutions Eng): +1. Can we create a short access bridge for hardware partners to request lab GPUs? Right now the ops form is too slow.
Lina (Enablement): What does "access bridge" look like? A one-click voucher? a short IAM role grant?
Sam (Eng-ML): For labs we usually do timeboxed VPN creds + ephemeral S3 buckets. Could automate via a signed URL flow.
Harry (SI Program Manager): Proposal: 1) self-serve voucher (30h GPU) via Google Form -> internal ticket -> infra-bot issues creds. 2) cert track gated by completion of two lab recipes + short quiz.
Maria (Partnerships): That sounds good. Also need alignment with cloud marketplace listing requirements — we can’t list SIs as "validated" unless the cert issuer has an audit trace.
Ajay (Solutions Eng): Audit trace = completion record in our LMS + verifiable badge assertion (OpenBadges?). We can issue a signed JSON-LD badge.
Lina (Enablement): I'll draft a 3-level cert ladder: Bronze (intro + 1 lab), Silver (two labs + deployment demo), Gold (customer pilot + runbook + SLA checklist). Badge metadata will include cohort id and HW access hash.
Sam (Eng-ML): For the hands-on labs, callouts: quantized model serving on A100, small LLM fine-tune on V100, and inference latency tuning on multi-GPU p2p. Need infra playbooks for each.
Harry (SI Program Manager): Can we make the lab infra reproducible with terraform modules + a canonical docker image? That speeds auditing and marketplace verification.
Ajay (Solutions Eng): Yes — pack the lab into a repo: infra/ terraform/, lab-runner image, and a readme with run commands. infra-bot can generate a temp creds token on successful form submission.
infra-bot: New request received: form_id=si-lab-voucher-2026 cohort=May-2026 requestor=partner-acme. Ticket #INT-498 created.
Maria (Partnerships): Great. Action items: Lina draft cert ladder + badge schema by Wed EOD. Ajay & Sam draft lab infra repo skeleton and deploy workflow by Friday. Harry to own voucher form + ticket flow.
Lina (Enablement): On it. I'll post the cert ladder doc in this thread when ready.
Ajay (Solutions Eng): Quick Q — do we want a mandatory customer pilot for Gold? That extends timeline but is the best signal.
Harry (SI Program Manager): Let's make Gold recommended but mark it as required for marketplace "Validated SI" badge. Silver qualifies for "Partner" listing.
Sam (Eng-ML): Also: include a short privacy checklist for data use during labs (no customer data, ephemeral storage, etc.).
Maria (Partnerships): Agreed. Lina, add privacy checklist to the cert requirements.
Lina (Enablement): Will do. Also thinking of a 30-min onboarding office hours slot weekly for cohort troubleshoot. Adds support but reduces friction.
Ajay (Solutions Eng): :thumbsup: weekly office hours is great. Also proposing a small quickstart repo: 
```
# quickstart
cd quickstart
./deploy-lab.sh --voucher $VOUCHER
```
That should be one command for partners.
Harry (SI Program Manager): I'll wire up the voucher lifecycle: issue -> redeem -> expire -> audit log. We should include a revocation path in case of misuse.
infra-bot: Ticket #INT-498 updated: creds_issued=false, next_step=infra-provisioning.
Maria (Partnerships): Timeline check: 1) Drafts by Fri, 2) Internal pilot with 2 SIs next week, 3) Marketplace badge flow + legal signoff in 3 weeks. Any blockers?
Sam (Eng-ML): Need a small test fleet of GPUs in APAC for that pilot. Ops team notified?
Ajay (Solutions Eng): I'll ping ops. @ops-team — can we reserve 4 GPUs APAC May 10-14?
Lina (Enablement): If ops confirms, I'll schedule the office hours and send calendar invites to pilot partners.
Maria (Partnerships): Perfect. Thanks everyone. Posting follow-ups here — please @mention when you update docs.
Ajay (Solutions Eng): Uploaded repo skeleton to https://github.com/redwood-inference/si-labs/tree/infra-bridge (private). Will add README and quickstart.
Lina (Enablement): Draft cert ladder: https://docs.redwood.ai/si/certs/draft-2026-05 (will update with badge JSON schema).
Harry (SI Program Manager): Voucher form draft: https://forms.redwood.ai/si-voucher-prototype (internal).
Maria (Partnerships): Closing note: for joint announcements, let's avoid "validated" language until legal ok. Use "completed program" phrasing. We'll sync on announcement template after pilot. :megaphone:
Sam (Eng-ML): Noted.
infra-bot: Ticket #INT-498 status changed to creds_issued=true at 3322112005.
Harry (SI Program Manager): Updated timeline — pilot invites sent. Will share retrospective thread after pilot.
Maria (Partnerships): Thanks — thread closed unless urgent.
